pages.text: $(d)Chat Detector$()$(br2)The $(d)Chat Detector$() emits a redstone pulse when the player that places it says a specific phrase in chat.$(br2)Set the phrase in its GUI. It's actually a RegEx field, so you can do more advanced filters. Just typing in the exact phrase is enough, however.

You can also toggle if the message gets canceled or not.$(br2)$(d)Global Chat Detector$()$(br2)The $(d)Global Chat Detector$() works the same way, but listens to chat messages from every player instead of only its owner.
It can only cancel messages from its owner, however.
